tuesday.topic: Patients who stopped coming, in 3 steps
caption: Three steps to win back patients who stopped coming.
Which step does your clinic skip today?
Message us DEMO and see it working.

tuesday.text:
Many clinics hold hundreds of records of people who came once and never came back.

The usual answer is to spend more on ads and chase new patients. Meanwhile, the people who already trusted the clinic never get a single message. Nobody decided to ignore them. There is simply no time left after a full day of calls and appointments.

A short, personal text can restart that conversation, and that is the kind of repetitive work automation handles well, leaving the team free to focus on the person in front of them.

Have you ever tried to reconnect with past customers? How did it go?
